'''1997 Sullust Regionals Gaetano Ferrara LS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaetano Ferrara]]
* '''Event:''' [[1997 Sullust Regionals]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah: Yoda's Hut
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Dagobah Yoda's Hut Ferrara LS 1997.txt |Download]]
